note: One formal threat model per asset class. tools/sync_skills.sh copies each document into the references/threat-model.md of every skill listed for it, and all of them into review-threat-model. scripts/check_threat_models.py checks structure and coverage.

models.title: General-purpose models (frontier API and open weights)
Restricted-access cyber-capable models
models.evaluation: none by design: access is restricted to a small, vetted group, so this asset class is managed by access control and oversight rather than a pre-enable benchmark

models.title: AI coding agents (a model inside an agent harness)
Agent features (computer use, memory, connectors and extensions, code execution, retrieval, multi-agent, background agents)
LLM applications (chat assistants, RAG and tool-using apps)
AI-assisted security tools (code reviewers, scanners of AI components, AI pentest agents)
